rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 2008, Islamic Oasis provides food relief and medical aid to low-income families and refugees [3]. Operating out of Chicago, the organization provides assistance through <cite id="2">zakat-eligible community programs</cite> and emergency response services [2]. In FY2024, Islamic Oasis reported <cite id="3">a total revenue of $4,794,010</cite> [3]. The charity offers services in various crisis zones, including global relief efforts alongside its local food pantry [4]. However, financial reporting shows a <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 5.3%</cite>, indicating that reported direct program spending is significantly below sector averages [1]. The organization maintains <cite id="1">17.2 months of working capital</cite> to ensure financial stability [1]. Independent evaluation from Charity Navigator gives Islamic Oasis an <cite id="1">overall score of 75/100</cite> [1]. While its long operational history and clear zakat designation appeal to faith-aligned givers, its low program expense ratio remains a central concern for potential supporters [1].
